theorem_meanings.shear_position_transport: Address pushforward new after inverse old is the shear by new minus old.
theorem_meanings.shear_payload_transport: The payload pullback reads by the inverse of the new-minus-old shear.
theorem_meanings.shear_endpoint_frames: An endpoint matrix difference equal to identity gives the common unit shear.
theorem_meanings.shear_all_role_endpoint: A typed scalar role permutation with difference-identity endpoints gives the physical unit shear on every original role.
theorem_meanings.ordered_shear_swap: The original three chronologically ordered address updates exchange the two address chunks.
theorem_meanings.partialSwap_involution: A partial swap from an idempotent additive endomorphism is its own inverse.
theorem_meanings.difference_idempotent: For two idempotent endomorphisms with both absorption equations, their larger-minus-smaller difference is idempotent.
theorem_meanings.partialSwap_nested: Large-after-small partial swaps equal the difference partial swap under the stated absorption equation.
theorem_meanings.partialSwap_nested_reverse: Small-after-large partial swaps equal the same difference partial swap under the other absorption equation.
theorem_meanings.complement_idempotent: Identity minus an idempotent endomorphism is idempotent.
theorem_meanings.complement_difference: Reversing and complementing a projector pair preserves its exact difference.
theorem_meanings.reverse_complement_residual: The complementary reverse transport is the same exact partial swap residual as the forward nested transport.
theorem_meanings.partialSwap_complement_frame: The complement frame equals a full address swap after the original frame.
theorem_meanings.partialSwap_complement_product: A projector and its complement compose to full address interchange.
theorem_meanings.selected_partial_swap_endpoint: A typed trace, scalar role permutation, and complementary endpoint projectors give physical interchange on every original role.
theorem_meanings.matrix_idempotent: The matrix equation P*P=P gives idempotence of its action on coordinate vectors.
theorem_meanings.matrix_absorption: A matrix absorption equation gives the same absorption equation for coordinate-vector actions.
theorem_meanings.matrix_complement: The action of the matrix I-P equals identity minus the action of P.
theorem_meanings.matrix_partialSwap_involution: A coordinate-matrix partial swap is an involution when P*P=P.

scope: Nineteen new conditional/general address-gauge theorems. No concrete full Lean Trace, prime-localization derivation, tape cost or multiplication theorem is asserted.
